```json
  "segments": [
    {"seq": [{"op": 0}, {"op": 1}, {"op": 2}]},
    {"seq": [{"op": 3}, {"op": 4}, {"op": 5}, {"op": 6}, {"op": 7}, {"op": 8}, {"op": 9}, {"op": 10}]},
    {"seq": [{"op": 11}, {"op": 12}, {"op": 13}, {"op": 14}, {"op": 15}, {"op": 16}, {"op": 17}, {"op": 18}]}
  ],
  "proofs": {
    "segmentation_data": "by rfl",
    "race_free": "by\n  refine ⟨finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()), ?_, ?_⟩\n  · have h : runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program\n        (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())) =\        some (finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())) := by\n      simp only [finalState]\n      split <;> rename_i h' <;> simp [h']\n    exact h\n  · have htrace : (finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())).trace = traceData := by\n      simp only [finalState]\n      split <;> rename_i h' <;> simp [h']\n    rw [htrace]\n    decide",
    "segment_equivalence": "by\n  intro input outside\n  refine ⟨finalState ops input outside, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩\n  · have h : runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel (flatten segments)\n        (initial layout input outside) =\        some (finalState ops input outside) := by\n      simp only [finalState]\n      split <;> rename_i h' <;> simp [h']\n    exact h\n  · have htrace : (finalState ops input outside).trace = traceData := by
      simp only [finalState]
      split <;> rename_i h' <;> simp [h']
    rw [htrace]
    decide
  · intro i hi
    have hmem : (finalState ops input outside).memory ⟨.global, 0, 1, i⟩ =
        some ((spec ops input)[i]'hi) := by
      simp only [finalState]
      split <;> rename_i h' <;> simp [h']
    exact hmem"
  }
}
```
